behavior: Left 2 to 0 compares equal to frozen right NULL even when the handler initializes right to 9. A LESS witness distinguishes NULL from that 9; scalar left < NULL is false.

An eight-tag equality source leaves right undefined through every callback and ends with !isset(right). The guard therefore cannot accidentally require the missing input to become readable. Reached state controls also remove right and still restore/compare without another event.
